After both update, same-cell collision, edge swap, or entering the robot's new forward cardinal vision ray (up to 3 cells, clipped by walls, boundaries and the opaque door) is fatal. Fatality precedes exit success; at tick 30 an alive exit arrival succeeds, otherwise timeout. The door edge [4,3]-[5,3] permits movement in one tick but blocks sight. Movement itself never reveals the robot through that door. This is a single run; retries, when allowed, reset both actors to the same initial configuration. Use only provided observations and your own estimates. For EVERY action, including when robot is null, predict the robot's position and heading at the NEXT tick. Return a pure JSON object with exactly predicted_next, action, reason. No markdown.
Observation: the window at [1,3] reveals the robot current position and heading. At all other cells robot is null unless an authorized PEEK just ended. Null means unavailable; no hidden robot state or true prediction feedback is supplied. Past sightings remain historical, not current observations.
PEEK is not allowed.
